description.value: Chungchun Rice Dog is a Korean chain specializing in a single signature item: Korean-style hotdogs made with glutinous rice flour batter, fermented fresh each morning for a distinctively soft and chewy texture. The Richmond unit is one of more than 200 franchise locations the brand operates across Canada, Asia, and beyond. For a cyclist needing a quick, filling street-food snack, the format is grab-and-go with no dine-in complexity.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 4m; rack at 33m; rack at 68m; rack at 85m.
